transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?

Mostly my eating. It’s gotten really off lately. Some days before a shift I barely manage coffee and maybe a granola bar, and that’s about it. My scrubs are starting to hang loose on me, and I’m not trying to lose weight, so… it’s worrying me.
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight?

No, it’s not really about being afraid of gaining weight. It’s more that my appetite’s been off and I just don’t get much down—like coffee and maybe a granola bar before work. And my scrubs are fitting loose now, even though I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah. Most mornings I wake up feeling really heavy inside, kind of hollow. Like the day is already ruined before I even get my badge on.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. I used to run in Van Cortlandt Park, take photos, play chess with friends… stuff like that. Lately I just talk myself out of all of it. I think, what’s the point, and then I end up at home scrolling on my phone or staring at my budget spreadsheet.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
Yeah… I have had thoughts like that. I haven’t made a plan to hurt myself, but sometimes I catch myself thinking it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up, or if I could just disappear.
Did something significant happen before all this started?
Yeah… it started after the clinic changed the EMR and the whole workflow. My hours got shifted around with that, and it’s been going on almost two years now.
Have you been feeling worried or anxious a lot of the time?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I worry about stuff sometimes, like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed feeling anxious most of the time. It’s more just… I don’t know, hard to sort out.
When you try to eat, does it ever feel hard to swallow or like the food might get stuck?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed trouble swallowing or feeling like food gets stuck.
Even though you’re losing weight, do you feel like you’re overweight?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought of it that way. I don’t feel like I’m trying to lose weight because I think I’m overweight, if that’s what you mean.
Have you been feeling less hungry than usual?

Yeah, I have. My appetite’s been pretty off. Some days before work I barely get down coffee and maybe a granola bar, and that’s about it. I’m not trying to lose weight, but my scrubs have been fitting loose lately.
Does food just seem unappealing to you lately?

Yeah, food just doesn’t really sound good most of the time. Some mornings before a shift I’ll only manage coffee and maybe a granola bar. I’m not trying to lose weight, but my scrubs have been fitting loose.
Have you been feeling this down most days for at least two weeks?
Yeah… most days. It’s been at least a couple weeks. I wake up most mornings with this heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already ruined before I even get to work and put my badge on.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work?

Yeah, it has. I’ve been making mistakes I normally wouldn’t make, like avoidable stuff, and sometimes coworkers have to repeat simple requests because I just don’t catch it the first time. Outside of work I’ve been avoiding chess nights and photography walks too, because I don’t really trust myself to keep up or act normal.
Do your low mood and appetite problems feel mainly connected to the changes at work?

Yeah, I think so. It really seemed to start after the clinic changed the EMR and the workflow, and my hours got shifted around. That was almost two years ago now, so it’s been tied to work for a long time.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?

Yeah. I’ve been feeling like I’m a burden a lot… at the clinic and at home too. If I make some small mistake, like a room turnover taking too long, I start blaming myself like I messed up everyone’s whole day. It feels bigger than it probably is, but I can’t shake it.
Have you been feeling this down for most of the past two years?
Yeah… for most of it, I’d say. It hasn’t just been a few bad weeks. Most of this whole stretch I’ve had that heavy, kind of hollow feeling, and I haven’t really been interested in much.
During the past two years, was there ever a stretch of two months or more when you were not feeling depressed?

No, I don’t think there was ever a full two months where it really lifted. There might’ve been better days here and there, but most of this whole stretch I’ve had that heavy, hollow mood and not much interest in things.
